name: 维修（检测/更换/校准）服务

map.按\"故障检测 / 零部件更换 / 精度校准\"三大模块逐项自查设备维修服务流程: Self-check the equipment maintenance service flow item by item across three modules - 'fault detection / part replacement / accuracy calibration' - automatically compute each module's compliance rate and the overall maintenance-service quality score, and output an improvement list.
map.📖 查看「金属加工设备维修检测评估 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Metalworking Equipment Maintenance Inspection Evaluation User Guide"
map.维修服务质量 = 各项实得分 ÷ 满分 ×100%: Maintenance-service quality = sum of actual scores / full score x 100%
map.每项按执行程度评分：未执行 0 分 / 部分执行 1 分 / 完全执行 2 分: Score each item by execution level: not executed 0 / partially executed 1 / fully executed 2
map.关键安全项（标★）未执行则整体不合格: Key safety items (marked star) if not executed make the whole unqualified
map.评估探测器的检出率与误报率。: Evaluate the detector's detection rate and false-alarm rate.
map.100 个含缺陷样本检出 95 个：检出率 = 95÷100×100 = 95%: 95 of 100 defective samples detected: detection rate = 95/100 x 100 = 95%; 5 missed need recheck or higher gain.
map.5，取 3σ = 65 为报警线：超 65 判可疑，兼顾漏检与误报。: 5, take 3 sigma = 65 as the alarm line: above 65 is suspicious, balancing missed detection and false alarms.
map.检出率和误报率怎么权衡？: How to balance detection rate and false-alarm rate?
map.提高阈值降误报但升漏检，降低则反之；安全关键件倾向低漏检（高误报可接受复检）。: Raising the threshold lowers false alarms but raises missed detections, lowering does the opposite; safety-critical parts favor low missed detection (high false alarms acceptable with recheck).
map.下 3σ 外概率约 0.27%，作报警线误报低；但缺陷分布非正态时需按经验调整。: The probability beyond 3 sigma is about 0.27%, giving a low false-alarm alarm line; but if the defect distribution is non-normal, adjust by experience.
map.金属加工设备维修检测服务质量评估工具，覆盖故障检测、零部件更换、精度校准三大模块: Metalworking-equipment maintenance inspection quality-evaluation tool covering fault detection, part replacement and accuracy calibration across 18 key points (including key safety items), quantifying maintenance-service quality and generating an improvement list.
map.分模块达标率与总体质量评分: Per-module compliance rate and overall quality score
map.机床/数控设备维修验收: Machine tool / CNC equipment maintenance acceptance
